description:
Use this when the user wants subtitles in another language on a clip: "add Spanish subtitles", "translate it
        to Japanese", "put the captions in Portuguese only". clip_id: from list_clips. language: a name or code (Spanish, es, Japanese, ja,
        Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic...) or off to remove the translation. mode: bilingual (default) keeps the spoken line
        with the translation under it; replace shows the translation only. Each caption line is translated once and
        keeps its timing, using RipClip's own model, so a long clip takes a minute.
        Not for: dubbing or voiceover (not done through assistants), how the captions look (style_clip, edit_clip) or
        the original-language captions (clips come captioned). Saved as an undoable version; the clip's video is
        replaced by the new render. Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame.
name: translate_captions
title: Translate captions
